reference_text_embedding: total value of promoted loans accessed by [specify the target groups] in the past [specify the period]

indicator_text: [Are the following functional responsibilities performed by different units or persons: (a) ordering; (b) payment; (b) recording of the transaction; and (c) custody of goods involved in the transaction?]
baseline: There is one person responsible for all described duties.
target: Segregation of described duties is formalized and accordingly implemented by sufficient people.
reference_text_lexical: Percentage of groups that report being able to use the group cash transfer according to project plans (based on identified priority needs in the communities)
reference_text_embedding: Percent of group members reporting that group cash transfer support is delivered in a safe, accessible, accountable, and participatory manner

indicator_text: Are cost allocations to the various funding sources made accurately and in accordance with established donor agreements?
baseline: There is no accurate allocation of expenditure and not according to donor requirements.
target: There is an accurate and donor compliant allocation of expenditures.
reference_text_lexical: % of households who received their cash transfers/vouchers in accordance with established timeline
reference_text_embedding: % of realized country budget to local partners

indicator_text: [Is the salary in an employment contract easy to reconcile with the payroll and finance accounts?]
baseline: There is no possibility to connect the salaries in the contracts with financial accounts.
target: Salaries in contracts are reconciled with finance accounts upon payment of salary.
reference_text_lexical: Percentage of supported groups reporting an increase in the capacity to design and successfully implement activities according to the communities’ priorities
reference_text_embedding: % of workers with formal contracts

indicator_text: Is the salary system in accordance with regulations in the country (income tax, pension, severance pay etc.)?
baseline: The salary system is not in accordance with country salary regulations.
target: All country regulations are followed in the salary.
reference_text_lexical: % of population in project area that trust the peace committee (or police, court)
reference_text_embedding: % of a realized country budget is directly received as cash by local groups
